plan: Use self-mill and card selection to stock the graveyard, then turn Zombie density into recursion, token production, and attrition. Gisa and Geralf, Cemetery Recruitment, Dread Return, Victimize, Scourge of Nel Toth, and Zombie Apocalypse reuse creatures; Cryptbreaker, Diregraf Captain, Diregraf Colossus, Rooftop Storm, and Door of Destinies turn that volume into pressure.

proposalRationale: The list contains exactly 60 copies: one command-zone card, 33 other singleton nonbasics, 9 Islands, and 17 Swamps.
All 34 nonbasic card names were selected from the parent source main, and every checked identity fits Gisa and Geralf’s blue-black identity.
The groupings explain a Zombie and graveyard plan; they are editorial organization, not proof of testing or strength.
The source commander remains unconfirmed. Gisa and Geralf is only the separate review branch’s suggested commander for this child.
